gloss: to revive, to come back to life

definitions.gloss: to revive, to come back to life
definitions.explanation: To return to life or consciousness after appearing to be dead or exhausted.

definitions.gloss: to be refreshed, to feel revitalized
definitions.explanation: To regain energy and feel rejuvenated.

examples.japanese: {冷|つめ}たい{水|みず}を{飲|の}んで{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: I felt revived after drinking cold water.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{伝統|でんとう}が{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: Old traditions came back to life.

examples.japanese: シャワーを{浴|あ}びて{生|い}き{返|かえ}った{気分|きぶん}だ。
examples.english: I feel refreshed after taking a shower.

notes:
{生|い}き{返|かえ}る means to revive or feel refreshed, literally "return to living."

WORD FORMATION:
{生|い}きる (to live) + {返|かえ}る (to return)

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Transitive pair: {生|い}き{返|かえ}らせる (to revive something)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冷|つめ}たい{水|みず}で{生|い}き{返|かえ}る: to feel revived by cold water
- {生|い}き{返|かえ}った{気分|きぶん}: feeling refreshed
- {伝統|でんとう}が{生|い}き{返|かえ}る: traditions come back to life

SIMILAR:
- {蘇|よみがえ}る: to be revived, resurrected (more literary)
